allowed_training_sources: public real distinct from current evaluation corpus

target_proposal.primary: Target keypoint evidence visibility: DIRECT/EXTERNAL/SELF and UNKNOWN or QUERY_MISS separated, aligned with human semantic annotation.
target_proposal.auxiliary: Exact query pixel target-instance presence stays a distinct output.
target_proposal.optional_local_support: Explicit finite-neighborhood target support is a new target; select radius using source validation only.
target_proposal.supervision_gap: Generic public instance masks do not supply pallet native8 semantic visibility. Verify matched synthetic support/state labels or annotate separate public pallet training images. Never use current evaluation labels for this.

minimal_model_proposal.head: small spatial target mask/readout queried at the specified location rather than pooled-only scalar
minimal_model_proposal.conditioning: target initial bounding region or wider context, query marker/coordinates and native keypoint index
minimal_model_proposal.semantic_loss: only on source rows with verified matching semantic states; mask missing/unverified states

public_real_candidates.name: BOP YCB-V real training
public_real_candidates.use: real visible target masks + poses/mesh for external occlusion source queries
public_real_candidates.limitation: not pallets; full-vs-visible mask does not directly give self visibility or human native8 states

public_real_candidates.name: Open Images V7 training segmentations
public_real_candidates.license: annotations CC BY4.0; images listed CC BY2.0 with individual-rights verification requested
public_real_candidates.limitation: IsOccluded is object-level external occlusion, not query/keypoint visibility

source_sampling: Sample actual source predictions and jittered queries, not only GT-centered crops.
Include low-occupancy center-positive and high-occupancy center-negative boundary queries to test area shortcuts.
Keep background, pallet holes, other instances, external occluders and query-miss distinct.
Use source video/scene/object splits; deduplicate against current evaluation corpus.
selection: Choose weights/radius/crop/threshold/epoch on synthetic and public-real validation. Current223 are exposed development evaluation; reserve a new session for final generalization.
future_ablation: A2x2 source comparison (synthetic vs synthetic+public-real) and current vs proposed readout/target package separates source effect from combined package effect. Match budget. It does not isolate readout from target individually. No runs started.
needed_for_real_pixel_diagnosis: Separate evaluation-only target-instance mask or explicit query presence annotations with boundary uncertainty; human semantic D alone cannot provide this.
